fusions.name: Sluggish Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a slow globule that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sun-Warmed Lash
fusions.desc: A tail lash that deals 14 damage, up to 1.4 times as much at its full reach of 5 tiles, and stuns the target for 1 second.

fusions.name: Basking Stone
fusions.desc: Increases the healing you receive by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Sunlit Shallows
fusions.desc: In daylight, your armour rises by 12%.
